observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Uniform bordered panels flatten every workspace into the same dashboard
observations.context: Overview, Performance, Security, and Whisper at 1280x820 dark theme
observations.action: Scan each surface for the primary task and next action
observations.expectation: One dominant instrument or working surface should be obvious before supporting context
observations.actual: Near-identical dark rounded rectangles, borders, padding, and headings give primary, secondary, status, and empty content similar weight
observations.playerConsequence: The app reads as a generated admin dashboard instead of a mature native system instrument, and task priority takes longer to parse
reproduction: Open the home, monitoring, security, and Whisper baseline captures
Compare the first focal point and relative weight of every panel
hypotheses: The shared container style is applied to nearly every group regardless of interaction role
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inspect the exact-head render matrix and then map shared container styles to semantic roles in the design system
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use unframed workspaces with one dominant instrument and reserve bordered containers for repeated actionable entities or true overlays

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: The rail spends more attention on persistent chrome than on orientation
observations.action: Move from current module toward another tool and assess global protection state
observations.expectation: Navigation, command search, profile, and global status should remain compact and easy to locate
observations.actual: A wide rail contains large unused vertical areas while a persistent amber protection card competes with the active page and truncates its own message
observations.playerConsequence: The shell feels unfinished and alert-heavy; a global issue can distract even when unrelated to the current task
reproduction: Compare the active navigation row, empty rail space, and bottom protection card
hypotheses: The shell reserves a fixed wide rail and places provider health in a generic footer card rather than a compact status center
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inspect shell layout constraints and the global status presenter after exact-head capture
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use a responsive native navigation rail and compact status center; promote only prioritized current risks into Overview

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Small low-contrast metadata makes precision look like noise
observations.context: Performance charts, Overview footers, Applications metadata, and status labels
observations.action: Read update time, source method, sample counts, current state, and secondary descriptions
observations.expectation: Technical metadata should be compact but comfortably scannable at the target viewport
observations.actual: Several secondary labels and monospaced readouts are tiny and low contrast, while large empty regions remain elsewhere
observations.playerConsequence: Important provenance and state details become harder to read without earning meaningful density
reproduction: Open the Overview and Performance captures at 100 percent
Read chart footers and rail/footer status without zooming
hypotheses: The type scale reduces metadata size rather than using hierarchy, grouping, and progressive disclosure
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Map typography tokens and measure contrast and effective size across 100 to 200 percent scaling
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use Segoe UI Variable roles with readable compact metrics, progressive diagnostics, and stronger spacing hierarchy

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Whisper repeats the same blocked state across banner, setup panels, rows, and badges
observations.action: Determine why dictation is unavailable and perform the next resolving action
observations.expectation: The page should present one guided next step with supporting diagnostics on demand
observations.actual: The not-ready banner, model panel, six readiness rows, yellow setup labels, and scaffold labeling repeat related state at equal visual weight
observations.playerConsequence: A capable fail-closed workflow feels like a diagnostic scaffold and asks the user to re-parse the same problem several times
reproduction: Open Whisper setup with the local model not installed
Count separate surfaces that restate not-ready or setup state
hypotheses: Readiness facts are rendered independently instead of composed into a guided diagnostics state
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inspect the readiness presenter and exact-head Whisper checks render
observations.recommendedOutcome: Lead with one actionable readiness path, keep the full checklist in a deliberate diagnostics view, and remove scaffold language only after live proof

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: The Applications data grid is the strongest mature-system pattern
observations.action: Search, scan, and compare installed software
observations.expectation: Dense system inventory should privilege rows, columns, search, and direct state over decoration
observations.actual: The view uses most of the workspace for a real searchable table with clear columns and minimal ornament
observations.playerConsequence: The surface feels closer to a native administrative instrument and provides a useful pattern for other data-heavy modules
reproduction: Compare useful content density with Overview and Security
hypotheses: The view succeeds because it lets the real system inventory determine the composition
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Verify keyboard, scaling, row actions, loading, empty, and error states in the exact-head runtime
observations.recommendedOutcome: Keep the data-first structure and use it as the density benchmark for process, clips, activity, and device workspaces

observations.label: UNKNOWN
observations.title: Static client-area renders cannot prove Mica, native caption buttons, or snap-layout behavior
observations.context: Software-rendered 1280x820 evidence without visible owner-host window chrome
observations.action: Assess whether the shell behaves like a Windows 11 application
observations.expectation: Mica, native title bar, caption buttons, snap layouts, solid fallback, and high contrast should be directly observable
observations.actual: The evidence captures client content only and cannot establish shell-level integration
observations.playerConsequence: A visual matrix could look coherent while the actual window still feels custom, flat, or incompatible with native shell behavior
reproduction: Inspect the current static render matrix
Observe that native caption and snap behavior are outside the artifact boundary
hypotheses: Shell integration exists but is outside the software-render capture boundary
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Launch the exact-head app on the owner host and capture full-window shell behavior, snap layouts, themes, and DPI
observations.recommendedOutcome: Keep this gate UNKNOWN until live native-window evidence exists
